privacy_redaction.hardware_identity: Public copy: physical GPU model and UUID are withheld; architecture labels do not identify a particular supported profile.
privacy_redaction.provenance: Measurements are retained. Embedded signatures, source digests and byte counts describe the private original records unless explicitly labeled as public-copy digests.
privacy_redaction.usage: Redacted review material, not an unmodified calibration input or a hardware identity attestation.

historical_cli_output_archiving: Repeated legacy training CLI outputs remain in artifact_root/release/wheel-checks; the archive retains their byte/SHA manifest, replay script and logs. Original expected reports are retained in the prior evidence archives.

independent_audit_summary.accuracy_failure_policy: Negative accuracy findings are preserved separately and do not fail the evidence integrity audit.
independent_audit_summary.audit: stdlib independent reconstruction of the predeclared expanded memory matrix

observed_envelope_coverage.scope: Empirical coverage of the observed five-calibration min/max on five later holdouts per exact workload, not a statistical prediction interval.

remaining_limits: Other GPUs, software versions, long-lived mixed workloads, offload, quantization and custom processors are unvalidated.
Analytical allocated accuracy and exact-workload reserved budgets are separate claims. New shapes/modes require new calibration; no physical OOM guarantee.
OOM boundaries and statistical prediction-interval coverage were not tested; existing experimental results for other workloads retain their original status.
scope: One authorized Blackwell GPU GPU1, frozen source/model files, fixed prompts and seed, native allocator, uncontrolled kernel caches. Public SD/SDXL eager or SDPA, attention slicing, VAE slicing/tiling and their combinations. No offload.
statistics_method: Unweighted phase comparisons across all declared holdouts; median, nearest-rank p95 and maximum. Allocated/reserved calibrated comparisons are pooled only in their explicitly labeled summary.
